trial.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: single continuous panoramic background for a Vietnamese production-history museum mural. Primary request: create ONE exceptionally ultra-wide horizontal image, 8:1 aspect ratio, intended export 8192x1024. Eight connected historical atmospheres read sequentially left to right: pre-1858 Vietnamese agricultural village and terraced paddy/thatched craft sheds; turn-of-20th-century steam railway, coal mine and river port; 1945-54 dispersed modest repair workshops; 1955-75 mechanical industrial hall and electricity; 1975-85 interconnected national factories and logistics yards; 1986-2006 sewing/manufacturing and container cranes; rural transformer and electricity infrastructure; fiber, server hall and modern data infrastructure. All blend into one authored continuous ground and horizon, with dense modest background architecture throughout, no isolated panels or centers. One consistent eye-level panoramic perspective, overcast neutral lighting, monochrome graphite/sepia engraving and archival drawing on warm ivory paper. Subdued low contrast appropriate behind foreground cutouts, atmosphere only, no large focal people. Shared horizon at roughly55% height, factory ground filling lower third, subtle structural details across whole width. No text, no dates, no labels, no numbers, no maps or country silhouettes, no red lines, no giant symbols, no frame, no borders, no repeated tiles, no visible seams, no political portraits/logos/flags. Historically plausible Vietnam tools/buildings. Do not photograph an actual museum wall. The image itself is the unframed historical mural background.
trial.reason: The tool did not return the requested 8:1 ratio.
